name: ai-governance-skills
description: Claude Code skills for AI Governance — dispatcher plus EU AI Act, NIST AI RMF, ISO 42001, NYC Local Law 144, South Korea AI Basic Act, Brazil AI Act, and CSA AICM / AI-CAIQ.

plugins.name: ai-governance
plugins.description: Dispatcher: injects using-ai-governance at session start so the agent invokes the correct specialist skill instead of mixing jurisdictions.

plugins.name: eu-ai-act
plugins.description: Classifies systems under the EU AI Act (Regulation 2024/1689); high-risk gap and operational checklists; Art. 27 FRIA; Chapter V GPAI; Art. 43 CE. Companion skill eu-gpai-cop for the Art. 56 Code of Practice.

plugins.name: nist-ai-rmf
plugins.description: Builds a NIST AI RMF 1.0 (NIST AI 100-1) Current vs Target Profile against the 72 official subcategory outcomes across GOVERN, MAP, MEASURE, and MANAGE, and applies the NIST AI 600-1 generative overlay.

plugins.name: iso42001
plugins.description: ISO/IEC 42001:2023 AIMS: gap assessment, SoA, certification, plus companions for AISIA, AI system register, data-for-AI inventory, A.4/7.1 resources, and AIMS policy/SOP kit.

plugins.name: nyc-local-law-144
plugins.description: Determines whether a hiring or promotion tool is an NYC Local Law 144 AEDT, produces DCWP bias-audit tables (above-median scoring rate; 7 EEO-1 categories plus intersectional), and drafts candidate/employee notices.

plugins.name: south-korea-ai-act
plugins.description: Classifies high-impact AI (고영향 AI, Art. 2(4)) under the in-force Korea AI Basic Act; maps Arts. 31–36, Art. 35 endeavor AISIA, and Art. 36 domestic representative. Decree No. 36053 is in force.

plugins.name: brazil-ai-act
plugins.description: Advises on pending Brazilian AI bill PL 2338/2023 (Senate substitute of 10 Dec 2024; not enacted) — risco excessivo / alto risco, rights, AIA, SIA/ANPD as proposed coordinator, GPAI/copyright preparedness.

plugins.name: csa-aicm
plugins.description: Fills CSA AI-CAIQ answers and AICM control gap tables from the user's AICM workbook; supports STAR for AI Level 1 and mappings to ISO 42001 or NIST AI 600-1 when those sheets exist.
